title: PureHealth acquires majority stake in Hayah Insurance and expands into life insurance and pension management
summary: The transaction advances PureHealth’s strategy to support health and financial wellbeing at every stage of life

The transaction advances PureHealth’s strategy to support health and financial wellbeing at every stage of life

Press Release

  • Expanded offering includes retirement savings plans for individuals and workplace savings programmes for employers
  • Daman will deliver the expanded offering as it evolves from a health insurer into a diversified, multi-line insurer

Abu Dhabi – PureHealth Holding PJSC (“PureHealth” or “the Group”) (ADX: PUREHEALTH), the largest healthcare group in the Middle East, has entered into an agreement to acquire a 67.5% controlling stake in Hayah Insurance Company P.J.S.C. (“Hayah”) (ADX: HAYAH) through its insurance subsidiary, Daman, marking another significant step in the Group's strategy to build a diversified, multi-line insurance platform. Once completed, the acquisition would expand PureHealth’s financial services business into life insurance, pension management and long-term savings.

Hayah, formerly known as AXA Green Crescent Insurance Company PJSC, is a UAE-based digital-first insurer serving more than 200,000 covered lives and over 1000 corporate clients. Its portfolio includes life insurance, pension management, loan protection, retirement and long-term savings solutions, for individuals and corporates.

Upon completion, Hayah will become part of PureHealth’s broader insurance platform, strengthening Daman’s existing capabilities and the Group’s position across insurance, while retaining Hayah’s digital operating model, management team and customer relationships.

The acquisition advances PureHealth’s strategy to support people’s health and financial wellbeing at every stage of life. Through its Care and Cover model, PureHealth already provides healthcare and health insurance. The expansion extends that role to helping people protect their income during their working years and build savings for retirement.

Through the acquisition, PureHealth is entering a life insurance market valued at approximately USD 2.5 billion in the UAE and USD 3 trillion globally. This positions PureHealth as an early mover in this high-growth market.

Alongside life insurance, PureHealth is expanding into pension management for individuals and corporates. The UAE introduced its voluntary end-of-service Savings Scheme in 2023, giving participating private-sector employers a way to fund benefits through monthly contributions to approved investment funds. For PureHealth, workplace savings are one part of a broader offering. Through Daman, the Group will help employers set aside funds for end-of-service benefits and offer individuals life insurance and long-term retirement savings plans.

H.E. Kamal Al Maazmi, Chairman of PureHealth, said: “The United Arab Emirates’ insurance and long-term savings markets are evolving, creating significant opportunities to support both individuals and businesses in planning for greater financial security. With the growing trend towards funded workplace savings and pension schemes, we see growing demand for solutions that enable employers to move beyond traditional end-of-service benefit arrangements towards structured pension management, while supporting employees build greater financial security for the future. Through this investment, PureHealth is strengthening its capabilities in life insurance, pension and savings solutions, expanding the range of end-of-service benefit and pension management solutions we can offer, and positioning the Group to capture growth in this market while diversifying and expanding our financial services revenue.”

Shaista Asif, Group Chief Executive Officer at PureHealth, said: “Our ambition is to build long-term relationships supporting people throughout their lives, and helping them plan with confidence for a healthier and more financially secure future. As the UAE continues to attract talent from around the world, we see an important opportunity to provide solutions that help individuals and employers manage end-of-service benefits through structured pension arrangements, alongside broader savings, pension and wealth management solutions that support long-term financial planning. By expanding our capabilities in these areas, we are broadening our role beyond healthcare and strengthening our ability to support people's financial wellbeing alongside their health. This reflects our ambition to extend both healthspan and wealthspan, helping people live longer, healthier lives with greater financial security.”

Under PureHealth's ownership, Daman has evolved beyond its leadership in health insurance, expanding into property and casualty insurance, achieving an A1 Insurance Financial Strength Rating from Moody's Ratings and now entering life insurance, pension management, savings, and protection through the acquisition of Hayah. The acquisition represents PureHealth’s disciplined approach to investing in higher-value insurance segments with strong long-term growth fundamentals. It also enhances the diversity and resilience of the Group's insurance portfolio by adding products that typically generate longer-duration policies and a more predictable stream of recurring premium income.

The transaction is subject to customary closing conditions, including receipt of the relevant regulatory approvals. Further details will be announced upon completion. Once completed, the transaction positions Daman as one of the UAE's few insurers with capabilities spanning health, property and casualty, and life insurance under a single platform.

About PureHealth:

PureHealth is the largest healthcare group in the Middle East with an ecosystem that challenges lifespans and reimagines health spans. With 110+ hospitals, 316+ clinics, multiple diagnostic centres, health insurance solutions, pharmacies, health tech, procurement, investments and more, its groundbreaking innovations are at the forefront of healthcare as the company is on a mission to unlock time for humankind. By advancing the Science of Longevity, PureHealth is introducing the healthcare of the future from the United Arab Emirates to the rest of the world.

PureHealth’s network comprises: 

  • SEHA – One of the largest healthcare networks of hospitals and clinics in the UAE
  • SEHA CLINICS - Delivering comprehensive community-based healthcare services
  • Daman (The National Insurance Company) – The UAE’s leading health insurer
  • The Medical Office – Overseeing Sheikh Khalifa Hospitals and healthcare facilities established under the initiatives of H.H. The President of the UAE
  • Rafed – The UAE’s largest healthcare Group Purchasing Organisation
  • PureLab – Managing and operating the largest network of laboratories in the region  
  • One Health – A network that provides end-to-end medical solutions to a base of over 300 healthcare service providers
  • The Life Corner – Abu Dhabi’s first holistic pharmacy, serving the health and wellness establishment
  • Ardent Health Services – The fourth largest privately held acute care hospital operator in the US
  • Circle Health Group – The largest independent operators of hospitals in the UK 
  • Hellenic Healthcare Group (HHG) - the largest private healthcare provider in Greece and Cyprus
  • PureCS - A leading cloud and technology services provider, specialising in IT management and consulting solutions, cybersecurity, cloud services and AI information systems
  • Sheikh Shakhbout Medical City (SSMC) – The UAE’s largest healthcare complex, delivering integrated complex care
